search_log: Searched for Stephen King From a Buick 8 excerpts, first chapter, and publisher material; opened sustained BookBrowse and Bookreporter excerpts of the Now: Sandy section.
Searched for From a Buick 8 point of view, narrator, first person, third person, multiple narrators, and alternating narration; opened the Publishers Weekly hardcover review.
Ran targeted searches for 'first and third-person,' 'Now: Sandy,' and 'Then' structure; opened detailed reviews describing the first-person frame and third-person flashbacks.
Checked Google Books and Hachette publisher pages; their accessible material was synopsis/catalog copy and did not directly establish the whole-book narrative person.
person_note: The novel alternates sustained narrative persons: first-person Now sections are voiced by Sandy and other participating Troop D storytellers, while sustained Then/flashback sections use third-person narration. The diagnostic Goodreads quotations contain both Sandy's first-person narration and third-person external narration of Sandy and Curtis, agreeing with the Tier B whole-book structural description and the authorized first-person excerpt. Generic aphorisms, speech, and clipped he-subject sentences were not allowed to vote mechanically. Some individual quote clips lack section headings, but the book-level alternation is strongly resolved.
